items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...or even Dizzy Gillespie's record, no matter what. But if you ask him about Classical things... You never said you listened to Classical music at all. [INTERVIEWEE] I never did.

ctx.x: It was made with that bell on it.
I mean, Dizzy uses that upturned trumpet, he claims, because he can hear himself play. Did Picou ever say anything like that, or did he just...
No. I was the only that could ever touch that clarinet, I'll tell you that. They put out another thing a lot similar to that thing called a saxello.
